Those three repositories must initially use warn-only enforcement, and generated-fixture paths must be excluded as a category in the configuration. The specific file paths don't need to be identified before settling; the config should exclude generated-fixture paths as a category. I found this during a separate QA validation task and haven't yet updated the rollout ticket.
